title: RoboTryOn: Synthesizing Dexterous Robot Demonstrations from Human Videos via Virtual Try-On
abstract: arXiv:2611.05163v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Robot foundation models have shown remarkable performance in robot control, yet adapting them to a new task still relies heavily on teleoperated demonstrations. Egocentric human videos offer a scalable substitute, but overlaying rendered robots on human videos or retargeting human poses into robot actions leaves significant visual or action gaps for high-DoF robot embodiments. To address this limitation, we propose RoboTryOn, which treats human-to-robot translation as virtual try-on: try-on keeps the person and swaps the garment, RoboTryOn keeps the demonstrated motion and swaps the human for the robot. Specifically, RoboTryOn converts a human video into a video of the target robot specified by a reference image, while preserving the original task, objects, and background. translated_title: RoboTryOn：通过虚拟试穿从人类视频合成灵巧机器人演示
translated_abstract: 机器人基础模型在机器人控制方面已展现出卓越性能，但将其适配到新任务时仍严重依赖遥操作演示。第一人称视角的人类视频提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，然而无论是将渲染的机器人叠加到人类视频上，还是将人类姿态重定向为机器人动作，对于高自由度的机器人本体而言都会留下显著的视觉或动作差距。为解决这一局限，我们提出了 RoboTryOn，它将“人到机器人”的转换视为虚拟试穿问题：试穿是保持人物不变、更换服装，而 RoboTryOn 则是保持演示的动作不变、将人类替换为机器人。具体而言，RoboTryOn 将一段人类视频转换为由参考图像指定的目标机器人的视频，同时保留原始任务、物体和背景。为了保持视觉一致性，我们以自回归方式对选定的关键帧进行转换，并用它们来引导视频合成，运动以人类（此处摘要内容不完整）
tldr: RoboTryOn 将人机转换类比为虚拟试穿——保持人类演示的动作不变，将人替换为由参考图像指定的目标机器人——从而从人类视频合成出视觉一致、保留任务与场景的灵巧机器人演示视频，为高自由度机器人提供可扩展的演示数据来源。
en_tdlr: RoboTryOn frames human-to-robot translation as virtual try-on—keeping the demonstrated motion while swapping the human for a target robot specified by a reference image—to synthesize visually consistent dexterous robot demonstrations from human videos, offering scalable training data for high-DoF robot embodiments.
